notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken ability, causing you to pay {1} to untap Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.
